response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId) THEN r.raceId END) AS race_count FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / NULLIF(SUM(race_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, COUNT(*) OVER () AS city_count FROM city_counts) SELECT city, race_count, share, share - 1.0 / city_count AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > 1.0 / city_count ORDER BY share DESC, city

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every non-NULL circuit city, including cities with zero races that have qualifying data.

alternatives.interpretation: Average the shares only across cities with at least one race that has qualifying data.
alternatives.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId) GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share, COUNT(*) OVER () AS city_count FROM city_counts) SELECT city, race_count, share, share - 1.0 / city_count AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > 1.0 / city_count ORDER BY share DESC, city
